[[File:Deeb.jpg|thumb|Possibly a pill of deeb, held by [[Lowbacca]].]]
'''Deeb''' was a consumable substance available on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] and shared its name with one of the [[moon/Legends|moons]] of [[Ambria/Legends|Ambria]].

According to [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]], if a [[Human/Legends|human]] used a bad deeb, their body parts may fall off. It had no effect at all on a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]]. Despite Leia's warnings to her children, Lowbacca was seen later holding a small sphere, smiling suspiciously.<ref name="Invasion 4" />
{{Stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Deeb was first mentioned in [[Invasion 4|''Invasion'' 4]], the fourth issue in the [[Star Wars comic books|comic series]] ''[[Star Wars: Invasion]]'', written by [[Tom Taylor]]. In that same issue, a speechless panel shows [[Lowbacca]] smiling and holding a small ball, apparently having purchased a pill of deeb.<ref name="Invasion 4" />
